boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten no-cost Lewis University intramural activities for current students, faculty, and staff with valid Lewis identification and a free IMLeagues account.

cards.title: Build a Basketball Team
cards.subtitle: Free intramural play at Lewis University
cards.notes: Gather classmates, create a team in IMLeagues, and check the posted intramural schedule before heading to the assigned campus court.
cards.short_summary: Organize a no-cost campus basketball game through Lewis Intramurals.
cards.evidence_claim: Lewis University lists Basketball as an intramural event and states that all on-campus intramural events are free to join.
cards.access_notes: Open to current Lewis students, faculty, and staff with a valid Lewis ID and free IMLeagues account; consult the current schedule.

cards.title: Meet for Volleyball
cards.subtitle: A free Lewis intramural team activity
cards.notes: Recruit a group or register as a free agent in IMLeagues, then confirm the scheduled venue and arrive ready for team play.
cards.short_summary: Join classmates for structured volleyball without an entry charge.
cards.evidence_claim: Lewis University names Volleyball among its intramural events and says every on-campus intramural event is free to join.
cards.access_notes: Participation requires current student, faculty, or staff status, a valid Lewis ID, and a free IMLeagues account.

cards.title: Form an Indoor Soccer Side
cards.subtitle: No-cost intramural soccer at Lewis
cards.notes: Use IMLeagues to assemble a roster or request free-agent help, and review the current listing for match time and location.
cards.short_summary: Play a scheduled indoor soccer match with a student group for free.
cards.evidence_claim: Indoor Soccer appears on Lewis University's intramural event list, and the university states that on-campus intramural events are free.
cards.access_notes: A valid Lewis ID and free IMLeagues account are required; availability follows the current intramural schedule.

cards.title: Pair Up for Badminton
cards.subtitle: Free racquet play through Lewis Intramurals
cards.notes: Invite a partner, register through IMLeagues, and bring a Lewis ID; the recreation center offers free daily racquet checkout.
cards.short_summary: Turn a study break into a no-cost badminton session.
cards.evidence_claim: Lewis University lists Badminton as a free on-campus intramural event and separately confirms free daily badminton-racquet checkout with a Lewis ID.
cards.access_notes: Current students, faculty, and staff need a valid Lewis ID and free IMLeagues account; equipment checkout requires the ID.

cards.title: Try a Pickleball Match
cards.subtitle: A free Lewis intramural option
cards.notes: Find a playing partner, enroll through the free IMLeagues account, and verify the event schedule before meeting at the venue.
cards.short_summary: Learn rallies and play a structured pickleball match at no cost.
cards.evidence_claim: Lewis University includes Pickleball in its intramural offerings and explicitly says all on-campus intramural events are free to join.
cards.access_notes: Restricted to current Lewis students, faculty, and staff with valid university identification and a free IMLeagues account.

cards.title: Round Up a Kickball Squad
cards.subtitle: Free team recreation on campus
cards.notes: Bring together a casual squad or enter as a free agent, then use IMLeagues to confirm registration details and game times.
cards.short_summary: Socialize outdoors or in the assigned facility during free kickball play.
cards.evidence_claim: Kickball is named on Lewis University's intramural event list, and all on-campus intramural events are stated to be free.
cards.access_notes: Bring a valid Lewis ID and register with a free IMLeagues account; dates and locations depend on the active schedule.

cards.title: Team Up for 3v3 Nerf
cards.subtitle: A free small-team intramural event
cards.notes: Recruit two teammates, register the trio in IMLeagues, and read the event rules and schedule before arriving at the assigned space.
cards.short_summary: Play a compact, team-based Nerf event without paying an entry fee.
cards.evidence_claim: Lewis University specifically lists 3v3 Nerf as an intramural event and states that on-campus intramural events are free to join.
cards.access_notes: Current Lewis students, faculty, and staff may participate with a valid ID and free IMLeagues account when the event is scheduled.

cards.title: Play Sand Volleyball
cards.subtitle: Free intramural play at The Backyard
cards.notes: Assemble a team, register in IMLeagues, and check weather and schedule updates before meeting at the mapped sand-volleyball area.
cards.short_summary: Share a no-cost sand-volleyball game in Lewis University's Backyard.
cards.evidence_claim: Lewis University lists Sand Volleyball among its free on-campus intramural events; the official campus guide maps sand volleyball at The Backyard.
cards.access_notes: Valid Lewis identification and a free IMLeagues account are required; play is subject to the current event schedule and conditions.

cards.title: Start a Wiffleball Game
cards.subtitle: No-fee intramural team play
cards.notes: Create a roster or sign up as a free agent, then consult IMLeagues for the current rules, game date, and assigned campus field.
cards.short_summary: Gather a group for an approachable, free intramural ball game.
cards.evidence_claim: Lewis University identifies Wiffleball as an intramural event and confirms that all on-campus intramural events are free to join.
cards.access_notes: Available to current Lewis students, faculty, and staff with a valid ID and free IMLeagues account when offered.

cards.title: Meet for Spikeball
cards.subtitle: Free small-group recreation at Lewis
cards.notes: Invite friends, complete the IMLeagues signup, and review the active event listing so everyone reaches the correct venue on time.
cards.short_summary: Practice quick rallies with a group in a free scheduled Spikeball event.
cards.evidence_claim: Spikeball is included in Lewis University's intramural event list, and the university states that on-campus intramural participation is free.
cards.access_notes: Participants must be current Lewis students, faculty, or staff with valid identification and a free IMLeagues account.
